_doc: SINGLE source of truth for Eldermark citizen FACE and BODY prompts (v3 age-hard). Both /fal and /xai-image MUST compose through face_prompt.py. Body uses the same age_stages + house style so limbs match faces.

style.frame: STRICTLY frontal head-and-shoulders, both ears equally visible, face centered filling roughly 70 percent of the frame, looking straight into the camera, chin level, shoulders square, no three-quarter turn, no profile, no looking aside, no head tilt, head fully inside the frame with a small even margin
style.expression: neutral closed-mouth adult expression, lips fully together and still, no smile no smirk no grin no teeth, eyes open looking into the lens, each iris SMALL like a real human (iris height about equal to the nostril, lots of white sclera on the inner AND outer corners, eyelids covering the top of the iris), no sparkle stars in the eyes
style.lighting: soft even studio key light from front-left, gentle fill from the right, very soft short contact shadow under the chin, no hard rim light, no dramatic chiaroscuro, no colored gels, no lens flare, exposure even across both cheeks
style.background: solid pure flat chroma-key MAGENTA screen background #FF00FF only, uniform hot magenta wall filling every pixel behind the subject, no grey wall, no teal wall, no mint wall, no sage wall, no blue-grey studio, no beige studio, no gradients no shadows no texture no floor line, isolated subject with zero magenta spill on the subject, no props, no architecture, no landscape, no window, no bokeh, no green screen

style.wardrobe: simple medieval European villager collar only at the bottom of the frame: plain undyed linen or wool neckline, muted brown russet cream or undyed grey cloth, no jewelry, no armor, no hood, no crown, no modern clothing, no logos, no turtleneck, no knit sweater, no denim, no jeans, no chambray, no blue work shirt, no collared modern blouse — never green, olive, or sage clothing

templates.face_system: Generate one catalog portrait of a real human. Follow the user prompt for age, sex, hair, eyes, and skin. Human-sized irises with visible sclera, closed mouth, linen or wool villager collar, solid MAGENTA chroma-key #FF00FF background filling every pixel behind the subject, unsigned blank corners with no text or signature. Not anime, not manga, not Pixar, not cartoon.

Age anatomy: {proportions}. Age markers: {markers}. Framing: {frame}. Expression: {expression}. Lighting: {lighting}. Background: {background}. Medium: {medium}. Wardrobe: {wardrobe}. {composition_lock}. {global_must}.

templates.young_deanime_edit: Keep this exact person's identity: hair-color family, skin undertone, eye COLOR, age, and bone structure. Restyle to match Eldermark adult villager portraits: semi-realistic painterly medieval European, visible brushwork, realistic skin pores. CRITICAL: eyes must be HUMAN-SIZED like a real person of this age — small-to-medium irises, not huge saucer anime eyes, not doll eyes, not Pixar, not manga lashes, no star sparkles in the eyes. Replace any hoodie or modern zipper with a simple linen or wool villager neckline. Remove any artist signature, watermark, initials, or handwriting in the corners — leave those corners clean and unmarked. Frontal head-and-shoulders, solid chroma-key MAGENTA screen background #FF00FF, mouth closed, calm. Avoid: anime, cartoon, chibi, moe, Pixar, huge eyes, oversized iris, plastic skin, modern clothing, green or olive clothing, signature, watermark, text.
templates.face_cleanup_edit: Keep this person's bone structure and identity. They must look {years} ({age_lock}). Hair must be {hair} — pigmented, not white, not grey, not silver. Eyes stay {eyes}, HUMAN-sized irises about as tall as a nostril with lots of white sclera. Closed mouth. Replace turtleneck or modern knit with undyed linen or russet wool — never green, olive, or sage. Fill the entire background with solid flat MAGENTA chroma-key #FF00FF. Leave all four corners clean, blank, and unmarked — unsigned canvas, no letters, no word marks. Shrink oversized irises to real adult scale.
templates.young_from_adult_edit: Make this the same person as {years} ({age_lock}). Keep identity, hair-color family, skin undertone, and EYE SIZE exactly like this source. Do not enlarge the eyes. Frontal head-and-shoulders, solid chroma-key MAGENTA screen background #FF00FF. No signature, no watermark, no text. Avoid: anime, Pixar, 3D render, cartoon, doll, moe, huge saucer eyes, oversized iris, manga lashes, hoodie, zipper hoodie, modern jacket, jewelry, earrings, artist signature, green or olive clothing.

defaults._DOC_daily_budget_hint: xAI ~200–300 images per 24h (user note 2026-07). fal has separate billing. Plan sessions inside this envelope.
defaults.cross_backend_note: Send the identical face_t2i string to fal and xai. Do not shorten, restyle, or model-specific rewrite. Fold compose_negative into fal --negative and into xai Avoid: via generate.py --negative. Full-grid campaign: python src/tools/regen_faces.py --generate --limit N (resumes via art/catalog/face/regen_progress.json).
defaults.pack_version_note: v3.8: face catalog T2I is fal-ai/nano-banana-pro (fal MCP recommended; Flux.1 T2I has no negative channel and ignored age/DNA/chroma). Bodies/events stay flux/dev. Banana payload uses aspect_ratio + optional system_prompt (templates.face_system).
defaults.decade_note: Engine labels twenties…eighties; 59→fifties. Dedicated face (120) and DNA-grid body plates exist for every decade band. Identity aliases in image-catalog.json; do not map decades onto young_adult/adults/elderly.

body_pregnancy._DOC: Catalog param pregnancyStage. Engine maps trimester first→early, second→mid, third/late→late; non-pregnant → none.

body_pregnancy.early: early pregnancy first trimester, subtle low belly fullness just beginning, chest slightly fuller, still mostly slender through the waist
body_pregnancy.mid: mid pregnancy second trimester, clear rounded baby bump front and center, tunic fabric drapes over the belly, hips and chest fuller
body_pregnancy.late: late pregnancy third trimester, large full round belly prominently pregnant, stretched tunic, lower stance, heavy with child
